title: Schema Layer

title: Network Layer
text: The network layer builds the communication graph, detects communities, and computes node activity history. All functions accept a DataFrame and CorpusConfig; no file paths or global state.

title: DiscoveryGraph.jl
text: DiscoveryGraph.jl is a Julia package for communication-network analysis in legal discovery contexts. It provides a reusable pipeline for building broadcast-discounted graphs from email corpora, detecting communities via the Leiden algorithm, identifying counsel-role nodes by graph position, and …

title: Requirements
text: Community detection uses Python igraph and leidenalg via PythonCall.jl and CondaPkg.jl. Run CondaPkg.resolve() once after installation to provision the Python environment.
